tools.name: get_account
tools.title: Connected account
tools.description: Which Tadqeeq account is connected: email, company workspace, role and plan, and whether this assistant may use Tadqeeq (الشاملة plan or the add-on). Call this first, or when other tools return nothing.

tools.name: start_audit
tools.title: Start an invoice audit
tools.description: Start auditing a delivery-platform invoice. Files cannot be sent through this tool: it returns a secure link (valid 2 hours) where the user uploads the order export and the invoice with the platform and bank fee already filled in. Give the user the link, ask them to come back when the upload says it is done, then call get_audit_result with the returned request_id. For HungerStation ask the user for their card/bank payment fee % first (e.g. 1.8).

bank_fee_pct.description: HungerStation only: the card payment fee percentage in the restaurant's contract, e.g. 1.8 for 1.8%.

label.description: Optional name for the period, e.g. 'سبتمبر 2026'.

tools.name: get_audit_result
tools.title: Get the audit result
tools.description: Result of an audit started with start_audit: the invoice comparison, differences to claim and costliest branches, computed by Tadqeeq's accounting engine. If the upload is not finished yet it says so; ask the user to finish the upload and try again.

tools.name: list_periods
tools.title: List audited periods
tools.description: Invoice periods already audited in the user's Tadqeeq workspace, newest first, with headline numbers (orders, sales, commission, platform charges). Use the id with get_period_summary, get_branch_performance or list_exceptions.

tools.name: get_period_summary
tools.title: Period audit summary
tools.description: Audit of one period: headline numbers, the invoice line by line (recalculated vs invoiced), open differences with the amount to claim, and the costliest branches. Numbers come from Tadqeeq's engine; explain them, never recalculate.

tools.name: get_branch_performance
tools.title: Branch performance
tools.description: Every branch in one period: orders, sales, commission, platform cost and the invoice-only charges its invoice section lists, largest platform cost first. Charges the invoice prints only in its consolidated summary are listed once as unallocated_charges.

tools.name: list_exceptions
tools.title: Differences to review
tools.description: Differences Tadqeeq found in one period (invoice vs recalculation, contract rates, compensations), open ones largest first, with the amount to review and what can be recovered. Use it to answer 'what should I claim from the platform?'.

include_closed.description: Also include differences already closed or recovered.

tools.name: list_branches
tools.title: List branches
tools.description: List the workspace's branches with their HungerStation, Keeta and Jahez ids.
